title: On groupoids beyond partial actions, inner amenability, and models for Kirchberg algebras
summary: We construct the first explicit examples of locally compact Hausdorff étale groupoids that are not inner amenable and that do not arise as transformation groupoids associated to partial actions of discrete groups. This answers questions of Anantharaman--Delaroche and Exel. Our examples include all Higson--Lafforgue--Skandalis groupoids associated to non-amenable residually finite groups, as well as their principal variants constructed by Alekseev--Finn--Sell.
